prompt: 我想给紧急订单系统加点东西，让它不只是'限时交货'这么简单。现在紧急订单和普通订单体验差别不大，就是多了个时间压力。我想让它感觉上更独特、更有存在感。有什么方案？

assertions.description: Each proposal has all required sections
Proposals reference actual emergency order mechanics
Each proposal explains HOW it differentiates emergency orders
Uses plain language, not invented compound nouns
Analysis addresses whether changes risk making EOs frustrating
